verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a scraping API that ships a CLI, SDKs, an MCP server and a self-hostable open-source build, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control. The community remark that AGPL lets you fork and strip what you dislike is a user-side workaround, not a product capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
